confirmed_findings.observation: Published archive member stream ended early; neither input was admitted. Original job IDs are no longer requeueable.
A recorded individual Slurm job ID was incorrectly combined with its array index. Reporting now queries JobIDRaw using the individual ID.
Failed assessment scheduler states are infrastructure errors, not completed sequence outcomes. Final release requires all current execution hashes and input bindings.

required_repair_guards: Recheck active jobs, execution records and partial output directories immediately before any action.
Never rerun a workflow with an existing execution, including genuine software or resource failures.
Preserve original IDs; record additional job IDs and source-bound receipts separately.
An assessment must wait for its actual producer and must not create an execution record before the producer runs.
